objective: Find Narain's Scrying Goggles and return them to Narain Soothfancy in Tanaris.

description: <You hear a sigh of relief escape the crate.>
You just want his scrying goggles? Great! That will be no problem... Just give me a minute to... Hey! Where the... Dagnabbit!

Well, there's some bad news and some worse news. The bad news is that I lost the goggles. The worse news is that I lost them when I was nosing around in the Molten Core last month. Yep, the Molten Core... I guess that concludes our business! Bye!
progress: The Molten Core, eh? I hope my goggles are still in one piece!
completion: Outstanding! Now where did I put that 500 pound chicken and Volume II of "Draconic For Dummies???" Oh, and here's a little something for all your hard work!
